crossRefs.note: When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat…
Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel were assembled to me, because of their trespass of the…
Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered…
For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple, and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought…
The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

people.name: Tobiah
people.line: Ammonite official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding efforts

translations.web: It grieved me severely. Therefore I threw all Tobiah’s household stuff out of the room.
translations.bsb: And I was greatly displeased and threw all of Tobiah’s household goods out of the room.
translations.kjv: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.
translations.asv: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.
